summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  22 UAE orders had rewards points incorrectly cancelled and returned to customers. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 stuck UAE orders investigated. 4 now COMPLETED. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after color swap and partial cancellation failure. DB state verified and Kibana logs traced. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed UAE orders have clawback processes stuck in RUNNING after Checkout.com declined the authorization. Root cause is declined card on file. Remediation script not yet created — awaiting confirmation on approach. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — only lock file and residual EOD generation logs exist. No RCA content yet. Full investigation and root cause analysis still pending. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file exists for this ticket. Investigation has not yet been initiated. Root cause analysis and remediation planning remain pending. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress — only lock file and residual EOD generation logs exist. No RCA content yet. Full investigation and root cause analysis still pending. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed mappings. 3 remain stuck — Galaxy A36 unmapped, invalid identity document, invalid product ID. Awaiting SMC team to resolve before retrigger via PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA .md file exists. Only residual EOD generation logs found. Full investigation and root cause analysis still pending. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation in progress — only lock file and residual EOD generation logs exist. No RCA content yet. Full investigation and root cause analysis still pending. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA daily sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. SaSalesReport.groovy needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers. Infrastructure already supports both fields. PC-53689 created with updated script. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Investigation in progress — 18 SA-region orders with refund failures under analysis. Ticket fetched and parallel fan-out launched covering Kibana logs, DB state, codebase trace, and PC ticket search. Root cause analysis still underway.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
